summary: Initialize physical fluid state with an explicit pressure frame and momentum-conserving pair exchange. Undefined zero-field beta is represented by None.

identity.relation: Physical species deck to cold/gyrotropic fluid equilibrium
identity.definition: rho_j=m_j n_j; P_parallel/perpendicular=rho_j cs_parallel/perpendicular^2/gamma_j; field-following P=P_perp I+(P_parallel-P_perp)bb. L_ji=K_ji/rho_j; L_jj=-sum_i K_ji/rho_j-bath_j.
identity.model: Multi-species nonrelativistic equilibrium with optional conservative pair momentum exchange and bath drag.
identity.geometry: Uniform field along z; local transverse density gradients may be supplied.
identity.coordinates: Cartesian x,y,z; positive pressure along the declared frame.
identity.boundary: Local Fourier perturbations; no finite-domain boundary solve.
assumptions: Pair exchange K is symmetric, nonnegative and has zero diagonal.
Collision generator acts on velocity perturbations; no inferred source collision-rate interpretation.

Fluid constants profile: c2=(2.9979e8 m/s)^2, epsilon0=8.854e-12 F/m, mu0=1/(c2*epsilon0), gamma default5/3. Charge and mass are explicit SI deck inputs; packaged defaults use q=+/-1.602e-19 C, me=9.109e-31 kg and mp=1.673e-27 kg. Sound speeds are direct inputs; no kB or temperature-to-speed conversion is performed. This is distinct from current kinetic initialization epsilon0=8.8542e-12 F/m.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.units: C; kg; m^-3; m/s; m/s; m/s; m/s; m/s; m^-1; m^-1
inputs.constraints: Finite; mass and density positive; sound speeds nonnegative. None loads the packaged independent two-species SI deck.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Uniform signed equilibrium magnetic field along z.
inputs.constraints: Finite; zero-field field-following pressure must be isotropic.

inputs.name: exchange
inputs.constraints: Nonnegative, exactly symmetric, zero diagonal; None means zero.

inputs.name: bath_drag
inputs.description: Independent momentum loss to an external stationary bath.

inputs.name: pressure_frame
inputs.constraints: 'field_following' rotates gyrotropic pressure with B; 'fixed_z' freezes its axes and sets magnetic pressure-rotation term to zero.

outputs.name: state
outputs.units: q C; m kg; n m^-3; v m/s; cs^2,c2 m^2/s^2; epsn m^-1; rho kg/m^3; B0 T; gamma,beta dimensionless; epsilon0 F/m; mu0 H/m; P Pa; Delta Pa/T; vA m/s; collision s^-1; charge_density C/m^3; current_density A/m^2
outputs.dtype: dict of float64 arrays/scalars, str, nullable beta arrays
outputs.constraints: rho=m*n; P=rho*cs^2/gamma. At B0=0 both beta arrays are None and Alfven speeds vanish; neutrality/current balance are reported, not imposed.

preconditions: Finite inputs satisfying the declared units and shapes.
supported: Physical SI decks of arbitrary positive species count.
Zero collisions, conservative pair exchange, and explicitly nonconservative bath drag.
Isotropic zero B and separately declared fixed-axis anisotropic zero B.
excluded: Implicit collision frequency semantics or automatically imposed quasineutrality.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError or a missing required mapping key rejects invalid inputs.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Dependency, numerical-library, or native-runtime errors propagate; no silent alternate provider.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result is returned on failure.

provenance.lineage_summary: Derived from the PDRK cold-plasma/PDRF example, with explicit D2 scientific corrections and state ownership.
provenance.license_status: pending-human-decision: source attribution is retained; redistribution permission and human scientific endorsement are unresolved.

python.signature: fluid_equilibrium_si(deck=None, *, B0=1e-07, gamma=1.6666666666666667, exchange=None, bath_drag=None, pressure_frame='field_following')

example.description: Initialize the packaged SI deck with zero collisions.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.multifluid import fluid_equilibrium_si
s = fluid_equilibrium_si()
assert s["velocity_collision"].shape == (2, 2)
assert (s["velocity_collision"] == 0).all()
example.expected: Two-species equilibrium with an exactly zero velocity collision generator.

scope: Momentum, common-velocity and dissipative-energy identities; physical SI holdout.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded derived scientific qualification exists. Integrated public signatures, executable examples, and final installed-candidate acceptance require separate verification.
known_limitations: Fixed-axis and field-following pressure are distinct physical models.
No global equilibrium force-balance proof is supplied.
